paite: Antiok a saptuam omte lak ah zawlnei leh thuhilhmi kuate hiam a-om ua; huaite Barnabas, Niger achih uh Simeon, Kurini khomi Lusias, kumpipa Herod toh khangkhawm Manaen leh Saul ahi uhi.
heading: Paul Leh Barnabas Sawlkhiakna
english: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

paite: Huan Toupa nna sem a an angolh lai un, Kha Siangthou in, "Barnabas leh Saul ka sapna nna sem ding in kei a ding in hon koihtuamsak un," achi hi.
english: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

paite: Huchi in an angawl ua, athum khit un atung uah akhut uh akoih ua, apaisakta uhi.
english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

paite: Huchi in Kha Siangthou sawlkhiak in apai ua, Seliusia ah ahohsuk ua, huai a kipan in Kupra tuikulh ah long in apai uhi.
heading: Kupra Tuikulh Ah Paul Leh Barnabas
english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

paite: Salamis a a-om lai un Judate sinagog ah Pathian thu agen ua; Johan leng amaute panpih ding in atonpih uhi.
english: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

paite: Huan tuikulh gam Paphos kho pha in anawksuak ua, bumsiam, zawlnei tak lou, Juda mi khat amu ua, amin tuh Bar Jesu ahi.
english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

paite: Huai mi gam-ukpa Serjia Paulus, mipiltak kiang a om ahi. Huai gam-ukpa'n Barnabas leh Saul asam a, Pathian thu zak atum hi.
english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

paite: Himahleh bumsiam Elimas, (huai tuh ama minkhiakna ahi a), amau nasep dal in ginna a kipan gam-ukpa heimang atum hi.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

paite: Huchi in Saul, Paul leng kichi; Kha Siangthou in adim a, amah a-ensal hi.
english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

paite: "Nang, mi khem leh huathuai chiteng a dim diabol tapa, diktatna tengteng melmapa aw, Toupa lam diktatte hihsiat na tawp kei ding maw?
english: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

paite: Thei in, tu in Toupa khut na tung ah atu hi, na mit ahong taw ding a, bang tan hiam khovak na mu kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in khomui leh mial in amah akhuh pah a, khut a kai ding mi zong in amai puampuam hi.
english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

paite: Huan gam-ukpa'n huai thilhih amu a, Toupa sinsakna lamdang asa mahmah a, agingtata hi.
english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

paite: Paul, atonpihte toh Paphos a kipan in long in apai ua, Pamphilia gam a Perga khua atung uhi; huai ah Johan in amaute paisan in, Jerusalem ah akiksan hi.
heading: Pisidia Antiok A Paul Thugen
english: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Himahleh amau Perga a kipan apai zel ua, Pisidia gam a Antiok khua atung uhi; huan Sabbath ni in sinagog ah alut ua, atu uhi.
english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

paite: Dan leh zawlneite laibu asim khit un, sinagog upate'n akiang uah mi asawl ua, "Unaute aw, mite hanthawnna thu banghiam na neih uleh gen un," achi uhi.
english: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

paite: Huan Paul adingh a, akhut a zap in agen a, “Israel mite leh Pathian laudan siamte aw, ngai un.
english: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

paite: Hiai Israel chite Pathian in i pipute atel a, Aigupta gam a ataam lai un ahih thupi mahmah a, ban thahat in amaute huai a kipan in apikheta hi.
english: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

paite: Huan kum sawmli gamdai ah athilhihte uh athuak teitei hi.
english: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

paite: Kanaan gam a nam sagihte ahihsiat khit in, agam uh aisan a hawm in, aluah ding un apia hi.
english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

paite: Huaite nung kum zali-le-sawmnga sung teng, zawlnei Samuel hun tan in vaihawmte ape zel hi.
english: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

paite: Huan huai nung in kumpipa angen ua; Pathian in, Saul kichi, Benjamin nam a Kish tapa, kum sawmli sung amau apia hi.
english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

paite: Amah asuanmang nung in akumpipa ding un David abawlta hi; Pathian in huai thu theisak in, David, Jesse tapa, ka lungtang bang pumi ka mukheta, ama'n ka deihlam ahih ding," achi hi.
english: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

paite: Hiai mi suan a kipan in Pathian in athuchiam bang in Israelte kiang ah Hondampa, Jesu kichi ahon dinkhia hi.
english: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

paite: Amah ahong pai ma in Johan in kisikna baptisma thu Israel mi tengteng kiang ah ana hilh masa hi.
english: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

paite: Huan Johan in asep ding azoh kuan in, "Noute'n kei kua na hon sa ua? Amah zaw ka hi kei hi. Himahleh ngai un, ka nung ah mi khat ahong pai dek, kei zaw akhepek a khetuam phel tak leng ka hi kei,” achi hi.
english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

paite: "Mite leh unaute, Abraham suante leh Pathian laudan siam Zentelte tengteng aw, noute kiang ah hiai hotdamna thu piak in a-omta hi.
english: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

paite: Jerusalem a omte leh amakaite un, amah atheih louh ziak ua siam louh atansak lai un, zawlneite thute Sabbath teng a asimte uh tangtungsak ana hi uhi.
english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

paite: Asihna ding khop atung a bangmah amuh louh nung un leng, Pilat kiang ah hihlup ding in angen uhi.
english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

paite: Huan athu zawlneite'n agelhkholh tengteng uh ahihtangtun khit un, sing a kipan in alakhia ua, han ah asialta uhi.
english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in misi lak a kipan akaithou nawnta hi.
english: But God raised him from the dead,

paite: Huchi in Galili gam a kipan Jerusalem a amah toh hohtoute kiang ah ni sawtpi akilak a; huai mite mah mi kiang a athu theihpihte ahi uhi.
english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

paite: Kou leng pipute kiang ah huai thuchiam a Tanchin kipahhuai ka hon puangzak uhi.
english: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

paite: Huchi a Pathian in Jesu akaihthoh, ei atate kiang ah huai thuchiam tuh ahihtangtung hi. Sam nihna ah, 'Nang zaw ka tapa na hi a, tuni in ka hon neikhia hi,' chih gelh bang in.
english: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’

paite: Muatna mun a pai nawn lou ding in Pathian in amah misi lak a kipan akaihthohdan ding hiai bang in agen hi, David kiang a hehpihna ka chiamte nangmah ka hon pe ding," chi in.
english: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

paite: "Huaiziak in Sam dang ah, 'Na Mi Siangthou muatmang na phal kei ding,' achi behlap hi.
english: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

paite: David zaw, Pathian vai hawmsak bang in ama khang hun a nna asep khit in, a-ihmu a, apipute kiang ah asial ua, amuatmangta hi.
english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

paite: Himahleh Pathian kaihthoh pen in zaw muatna amu kei hi.
english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw thei un; amah ziak in khelhna ngaihdamna thu na kiang ua gen ahi.
english: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

paite: Kuapeuh agingta tuh bangkim ah amah siamtansak in a-om, huai lah Mosi Dan in siamtansak in na om thei kei uhi.
english: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

paite: Huaiziak in pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw zawlneite a agen uh na tung uah ahong tung kha ding hi."
english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

paite: "Musitte aw, en un, lamdang sa unla, mangthang un; na damsung un nna khat ka sem hi, huai nna mi'n hon hilh mah le uh, na gingta kei hial ding uhi, chih," achi hi.
english: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”

paite: Huan apawt un, Sabbath nawn chiang a huai thute gen nawn ding in angen uhi.
english: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

paite: Huan omkhawmte akikhentak un, Judate leh phungkaite Pathian limsak lak a mi tampi in Paul leh Barnabas azui zel ua; amau ana houpih ua, Pathian hehpihna a om gige ding in ahanthawn uhi.
english: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

paite: Huan Sabbath nawn in akhozang phial un Pathian thu ngaikhe ding in ahong kikhawm uhi.
heading: Zentelte Kiang Lam Ngatna
english: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

paite: Himahleh Judate'n mipite amuhtak un ahaza mahmah ua; Paul thugente kalh in agensia uhi.
english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

paite: Huchi in Paul leh Barnabas in hangsantak in adawng ua, "Pathian thu noumau kiang ah gen masak ding him ahi; himahleh na nial ua, tangtawn a hing tak lou a na kiseh nung un, thei un, Zentelte lam ka ngata uh," achi uhi.
english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

paite: Huchibang in Toupa'n thu ahon pia hi, "Zentelte hihvakpa ding in ka hon sep a, kawlmong pha a Hondampa dia na omtheihna ding in, chih gelh bang in,” achi hi.
english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”

paite: Zentelte'n huai thu azak un, akipak ua, Toupa thu apahtawi ua, tangtawn a hing ding a sehkholh peuhmah in agingta uhi.
english: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

paite: Toupa thu huai gam kimvel ah adalhta hi.
english: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

paite: Himahleh Judate'n numei zahtakhuai Pathian limsakte leh kho upate hanthawn in, Paul leh Barnabas soisasak in, agam ua kipan adelhkhia uhi.
english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

paite: Amau leng atung uah akhepek ua leivui asingkhia ua, Ikoniam ah apaita uhi.
english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

paite: Huan nungzuite kipahna leh Kha Siangthou in adim chiat uhi.
english: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
